top_repositories.momentum: Extremely strong with over 600 star growth in a short window and high fork engagement.
top_repositories.novelty: Very high, capturing the bleeding-edge paradigm of configuring local developer AI agents with discrete behavioral 'skills'.

top_repositories.novelty: High—effectively marries browser design canvas tools with modern AI prompt engineering.

top_repositories.name: 2akouwu/reverify
top_repositories.reason: Tackles AI hallucinations head-on by coupling an MCP server and CLI with deterministic tools, ensuring every claim is checked against ground truth.
top_repositories.why_interesting_today: AI hallucination and verification remain the biggest operational bottlenecks for autonomous coding and reverse-engineering agents.
top_repositories.why_developers_should_care: Provides an MCP-compliant architecture where deterministic tools make the final call on code, binary analysis, or context claims rather than trusting LLM outputs blindly.
top_repositories.momentum: Solid emerging traction with steady interest from the developer-tools and AI security niches.
top_repositories.novelty: Innovative combination of MCP server architecture with strict deterministic grounding and reverse-engineering verification.
